# Pendo (pendo.io) Tech Stack Investigation (2022–2023)

Based on archived page source inspection, CDX records, and technographic profiling of `pendo.io` during the 2022–2023 period, here is the tech stack breakdown organized by category:

---

## 1. CMS & Website Platform
* **WordPress:** Main marketing website (`pendo.io`), blog (`pendo.io/blog/`), and resource hubs (`pendo.io/resources/`), utilizing custom themes and Custom Post Types (CPTs) for blog, glossary, and customer stories.
* **Marketo Forms / Landing Page Engine:** Forms and gated content engine integrated into marketing pages and subdomains.
* **Static / Headless Components (Gatsby / Next.js):** Utilized for high-performance sub-pages, interactive tour components, and documentation modules.

---

## 2. Tracking Pixels, Analytics & Marketing Automation
* **Tag Management:** Google Tag Manager (GTM - `googletagmanager.com`) as the central tag container.
* **Analytics & CDP:**
  * **Google Analytics (UA & GA4):** Web analytics and traffic tracking.
  * **Segment (`segment.io`):** Customer Data Platform (CDP) for cross-platform event collection and routing.
  * **Pendo Self-Tracking (`pendo.js` / `snippet.js`):** In-app & marketing site analytics, guide delivery, and visitor tracking using Pendo's own product.
* **Marketing Automation & CRM:**
  * **Adobe Marketo Engage (`mktoresp.com` / `marketo.com`):** Lead scoring, email nurture workflows, gated resource capture.
  * **Salesforce Integration:** CRM backend sync for lead qualification.
* **Account-Based Marketing (ABM) & Retargeting:**
  * **Demandbase & 6sense:** IP lookup, firmographic audience identification, and B2B intent tracking.
  * **LinkedIn Insight Tag, Meta (Facebook) Pixel, Google Ads Remarketing Tag:** Retargeting and ad conversion tracking.
* **Conversational Marketing & Scheduling:**
  * **Drift:** Live chat widget and automated conversational bot.
  * **Chili Piper:** In-line routing and meeting scheduling on demo/contact forms.

---

## 3. LP & Demand Gen Subdomains
* **`go.pendo.io`:** Primary Marketo-hosted and integrated landing page subdomain for webinars, gated ebooks, whitepapers, event registrations, and trial signups.
* **`pages.pendo.io` & `info.pendo.io`:** Campaign landing pages, redirect proxies, and demand generation subdomains.
* **`resources.pendo.io`:** Educational resource delivery and asset hosting.
* **`academy.pendo.io`:** Learning management portal for Pendo certifications.
* **`help.pendo.io` / `developers.pendo.io`:** Customer support knowledge base and developer API documentation.
* **`app.pendo.io` (`us1.app.pendo.io`, `eu.pendo.io`):** Core SaaS application platform and data ingestion endpoints.

---

## 4. CSS & JS Libraries / Frontend Frameworks
* **JavaScript Frameworks & Libraries:**
  * **React.js:** Core UI framework for application features, interactive marketing components, and Pendo guide overlays.
  * **Next.js & Gatsby:** Static site generator frameworks for micro-sites and documentation.
  * **jQuery & Lodash / Underscore:** Utility JS libraries bundled within WordPress themes and plugins.
* **CSS Frameworks & Toolkits:**
  * **Bootstrap & Custom SCSS:** Layout grid and component styling for legacy marketing templates.
  * **Tailwind CSS:** Utility-first CSS framework for modern web pages and sub-components.
  * **Font Awesome & SVG Icon Kits:** Iconography across navigation and feature blocks.
